tasks.title: Run full test suite and verify all tests pass
tasks.description: Run the complete Vitest test suite to verify all existing tests pass. READ FIRST: package.json for test script. Run: npx vitest run from the project root. Also run npx tsc --noEmit to check for TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run exits code 0 with all tests passing
npx tsc --noEmit exits code 0 with no TypeScript errors
